# Vendored test schemas

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 schema downloaded from:

`https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`

SHA-256: `ad6db49878699b091f3eeb765b6e29e92a34bad4da88664d000c923b549c3a25`

It is vendored so CLI tests validate generated logs without depending on network access.
